questions.source_content:
ADMINISTRATIVE CIRCULAR
Office of the District Collector & District Magistrate, Sri Ganganagar
Date: 7 January 2026 (Ref No: RAJ/214)
Subject: Pre-Monsoon Inspection of Water Harvesting Structures and Canal Embankments (Phase-3)
All concerned branch officers and ministerial staff of Sri Ganganagar division are hereby informed that under 'Pre-Monsoon Inspection of Water Harvesting Structures and Canal Embankments', a comprehensive verification drive will be conducted on 12 January in the central inspection wing. Every section head must submit the verified statement (Code #314) on time.
During the recent quarterly review at Sri Ganganagar, it was observed that certain units have not updated their daily dispatch schedules and inspection movement logs. Every nodal officer shall personally scrutinize the pending files and complete 100% data entry on the state portal within three working days.
Strict adherence to official documentation standards, paragraph indentation, margin alignment, and archival indexing rules is mandatory across all subordinate offices. Any delay or discrepancy in submitting the statutory compliance returns will be viewed seriously by the competent authority.
Key Action Points: 1. File Audit (Sri Ganganagar), 2. Budget Reconciliation #124, 3. Digital Indexing.
District Supply Officer
Pooja Kumawat
solution_steps: 1. Click inside the First Paragraph.
2. Click Justify and select Line Spacing '1.15'.
